description: Research-only modular sleeve metadata mirrored against the canonical strategy registry. This manifest does not independently authorize trading, execution, allocation, cron, or live-capital behavior.

sleeves.thesis: Reference momentum security-selection sleeve and historical research comparison baseline; it remains shadow-only and has no PAPER execution authority.
sleeves.intended_market_environment: Broad large-cap equity regimes where cross-sectional momentum remains persistent after transaction costs.
sleeves.rebalance_cadence: daily shadow observation; parity checks must match existing cadence before abstraction migration
sleeves.holding_count_policy: Preserve existing Polaris holding-count behavior; do not change in Phase B.
sleeves.risk_profile: Baseline core-momentum risk profile; compare drawdown, concentration, turnover, and beta to existing artifacts.
promotion_requirements: No automatic promotion from the historical shadow baseline.
Any generalized harness migration must first prove Polaris parity against existing behavior.
sleeves.retirement_policy: No retirement decision is allowed in Phase B.

sleeves.thesis: Forward shadow concentration variant of Polaris intended to test whether top-4 momentum concentration improves alpha per deployed dollar without disproportionate drawdown.
sleeves.intended_market_environment: Broad large-cap equity regimes where Polaris-style cross-sectional momentum is strong enough that concentration may improve return capture.
sleeves.rebalance_cadence: Daily shadow observation only; no paper, live, broker, scheduler, allocator, or production behavior change.
sleeves.holding_count_policy: Top 4 highest-ranked Polaris momentum names, equal weighted with 20% max-position cap; residual cash is expected and measured.
sleeves.risk_profile: High-concentration core momentum challenger; compare return, drawdown, turnover, concentration, HHI/effective N, and alpha-per-dollar proxy versus Polaris.
promotion_requirements: 20 trading-day checkpoint: complete forward shadow chain, no execution impact, compare return/drawdown/turnover/concentration versus Polaris.
60 trading-day checkpoint: positive alpha-per-dollar proxy versus Polaris and SPY after costs with drawdown not disproportionate to concentration.
Decision-grade PIT evidence remains required before paper, pilot, or capital allocation promotion.
Owner approval required before any promotion, allocation, or production behavior change.
sleeves.retirement_policy: Retire or shelve if concentration fails to improve alpha-per-dollar proxy, materially worsens drawdown, or cannot maintain artifact continuity.

sleeves.thesis: Owner-approved PAPER-only momentum authority using the governed rank-decay/exit snapshot; live remains blocked and research promotion claims still require decision-grade PIT evidence.
sleeves.intended_market_environment: Large-cap momentum regimes where faster decay and exit rules may improve drawdown or turnover-adjusted return.
sleeves.rebalance_cadence: Daily governed shadow snapshot supplies the PAPER-only target under the current/previous-session freshness contract; no live authority.
sleeves.holding_count_policy: Preserve existing Orion holding-count behavior; document from artifacts before any abstraction migration.
sleeves.risk_profile: Core-momentum challenger; compare active share, concentration, turnover, drawdown, and regime behavior versus Polaris and Lyra.
promotion_requirements: 20/40/60-day observation gates where relevant.
Decision-grade PIT evidence.
Material differentiation from Polaris and Lyra.
Owner approval before promotion, retirement, rename, or allocation changes.
sleeves.retirement_policy: No retirement decision is allowed in Phase B; future retirement requires owner-approved evidence threshold.

sleeves.risk_profile: High-concentration core momentum challenger; compare return, drawdown, turnover, concentration, HHI/effective N, and alpha-per-dollar proxy versus Orion.
promotion_requirements: 20 trading-day checkpoint: complete forward shadow chain, no execution impact, compare return/drawdown/turnover/concentration versus Orion.

Decision-grade PIT evidence remains required before paper, pilot, or capital allocation promotion.
Owner approval required before any promotion, allocation, or production behavior change.

sleeves.thesis: Crisis-reversal sleeve intended to identify oversold, high-quality recovery candidates after broad stress.
sleeves.intended_market_environment: Drawdown, volatility shock, or post-crisis recovery regimes.
sleeves.rebalance_cadence: To be specified; likely event/regime gated rather than always-on daily production behavior.
sleeves.holding_count_policy: To be specified through research; no production target count in Phase B.
sleeves.risk_profile: High regime sensitivity; must quantify drawdown capture, recovery beta, liquidity, and concentration risk.
promotion_requirements: Pre-registered crisis-window definition.
PIT evidence excluding holdout.
Recovery/drawdown improvement after costs.
Owner approval before any shadow or paper behavior.
sleeves.retirement_policy: Shelve if crisis-window signal fails preregistered evidence or cannot avoid look-ahead bias.

sleeves.thesis: Post-earnings drift/event-reaction sleeve; v0 is shelved pending consensus/EPS-surprise data for v1.
sleeves.intended_market_environment: Single-name earnings events with measurable surprise, drift, and liquidity after announcement.
sleeves.rebalance_cadence: Event-driven; no production cadence in Phase B.
sleeves.holding_count_policy: To be determined by event frequency, liquidity, and overlap controls.
sleeves.risk_profile: Event concentration and gap-risk sensitive; requires event-tape quality diagnostics.
promotion_requirements: Vendor/consensus surprise data available PIT.
Coverage and cost-sensitivity pass.
Owner approval before v1 holdout access or shadow behavior.
sleeves.retirement_policy: Remain shelved until v1 data dependency is solved; retire only with explicit owner approval.
